# Miroooo

Miroooo is a UK-focused electric toothbrush brand offering two models: Miroooo X and Miroooo X2. The store uses UK English and prices products in GBP.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://miroooo.co/): Brand and product overview.
- [Shop](https://miroooo.co/shop): Model comparison and buying routes.
- [Miroooo X](https://miroooo.co/products/miroooo-x): Lightweight model with three modes and 60+ days of battery life.
- [Miroooo X2](https://miroooo.co/products/miroooo-x2): Guided model with pressure feedback, IPX7 water resistance and up to 90 days of battery life.
- [FAQs](https://miroooo.co/faq): Product, care, delivery and return answers.
- [Delivery and returns](https://miroooo.co/delivery-returns): UK fulfilment estimates and the 90-day home trial.
- [Warranty](https://miroooo.co/warranty): Two-year limited warranty terms.

## Important context

- Product information supports general oral-care routines and does not replace advice from a dentist or hygienist.
- Delivery dates and battery durations are estimates that vary with circumstances and use.
- The final price, bundle contents and availability shown at checkout control an order.
